dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave parabolic curvature along the trailing edge, originating from a wide base and tapering to a posterior-pointing apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex exhibits a rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin maintains a linear slope of approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc defining a smooth, rounded forehead contour.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a thick base and low length-to-width ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon arc and the rostrum ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch visible on the lower third of the dorsal fin's trailing edge; scattered circular light-colored depigmentation marks on the melon and dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent light-colored diagonal flank patch extending from the dorsal region towards the ventral-posterior area.
